scene.source: NATURAL drive — flat-plate wind force on pitched blades (dynamics/mechanisms/wind.py, SIMPLIFIED_MODEL flagged there; closed-form static torque and terminal tip speed gated in tests/test_mechanism_wind.py). Wind 10 m/s along +x; blade pitch 45 deg; terminal omega* = 16.67 rad/s emerges, not prescribed. Mounted on RigidBearing (see KNOWN_GAPS.md). Nothing plugged. CHOSEN: rotor blade material = 'aluminum' (checked: sigma_ground.field.interface.surface.MATERIALS (25 entries); alternatives: carbon_fiber — real wind-turbine blade composite, steel_mild — traditional farm-windmill sail material; aluminum sheet is plausible for this flat-plate (non-airfoil) blade model, but no comparison against the composite/steel alternatives was recorded before picking it) CHOSEN: hub and mast/tower material = 'iron' (checked: sigma_ground.field.interface.surface.MATERIALS (25 entries); alternatives: steel_mild — the real material wind-turbine towers and hub castings are built from; iron is plausible for a cast hub but not realistic for a load-bearing tower; steel_mild was never checked before iron was carried over from the hub pick to the mast too) CHOSEN: rotor/blade geometry (count, length, chord, thickness, pitch, centroid radius) and hub cylinder size = {'n_blades': 4, 'blade_length_m': 0.5, 'blade_chord_m': 0.15, 'blade_thickness_m': 0.004, 'blade_pitch_deg': 45.0, 'radius_centroid_m': 0.6, 'hub_r_m': 0.08, 'hub_h_m': 0.1} (checked: sigma_ground/blueprint/catalog/ (only the clock's Kelly 1944 entry exists — no wind-rotor design catalog in this codebase); no blueprint for wind-rotor geometry exists; every value picked to be a plausible small-turbine demo scale — pitch in particular sets terminal_omega directly and is not derived from any target tip-speed ratio) CHOSEN: ambient wind speed (m/s) = 10.0 (alternatives: 5.0; round demo scenario input, not a looked-up quantity; also offered as a labeled 5 m/s scene variant)
